title: Drive Loader
author: Iced-Cream
description: The +Drive mods loader's flashed part (core-ar2 0.14 and newer, OS 1.74). The boot linker, run in core's ev_boot_drive, which links the mods chosen in /mods/active into the +Drive mods' area at boot (skip with [NO] held; a crash guard skips once after a start that didn't get 10 s in), and the /mods route: a top-level /mods in the unit's Data root listing, holding the .elemod files in the +Drive's /mods folder, which a client such as elekloader lists, reads, uploads and deletes over USB; /mods/.build is the build descriptor (core_desc), /mods/.status the loader's status in plain text; and the MODS page at the bottom of SETTINGS > GLOBAL, a SAMPLES-style file browser: the ticked files are the build, and LOAD TO BUILD saves them to /mods/active only when the boot linker's checks pass them.
